overview: Meta's Muse Wonder frontier model launched, with strong early praise from Tobi Lütke and Matthew Berman despite quota limits at launch that Berman says were quickly fixed. Microsoft committed to its own Maia chips at multi-gigawatt scale, and X merged Grok, Cursor and X Premium into one subscription while Elon Musk spent the night promoting Grok Bot. Chamath shared a study arguing that model leaderboards can mislead without harness testing.

top_items.title: tobi - Meta's new Muse Wonder frontier model is 'very very good' and handled tasks other top models failed, says Shopify's CEO
saranormous - Microsoft says its Maia 300 chip gives 40% more tokens per watt and will scale to multi-gigawatt deployments next year
chamath - 8090 Labs test: same model scored 24% or 59% on 113 coding tasks depending on harness; Claude Fable 5.1 did better in Codex
X - New 'X Subscription' bundles Grok, Cursor and X Premium; X says it costs the same as Premium or less
elonmusk - Musk spent the night promoting Grok Bot, including a new feature that imports memory from ChatGPT or Claude
elonmusk - Tesla Robotaxi now runs 6am-11pm with shorter waits, an auto-opening trunk and Grok Bot inside the Cybercab
demishassabis - The Lancet published Google's AMIE study, the first prospective real-clinic trial of a patient-facing AI diagnostic chat
DavidSacks - Sacks says Anthropic reports cutting data harvested from Claude in distillation attacks by around 90-99%
